label: Площадь
description: Twelve-mission case drill for площадь (square, plaza) — all six cases, singular and plural.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative singular. The dictionary form площадь is the subject being described, so it keeps its bare -ь shape. Third-declension feminine nouns carry no ending in the nominative singular; the case marking only appears once the noun shifts into the oblique forms.

missions.phrase: Туристы идут от площади к реке.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive singular. The preposition от governs the genitive, and площадь shifts to площади. A defining feature of the third declension is that genitive, dative, and prepositional singular all collapse into this single -и form, so площади here matches the dative and prepositional exactly.

Strategic focus: Dative singular. The preposition к governs the dative, marking the square as the goal of movement, and the form becomes площади. In the third declension the dative shares its -и ending with the genitive and prepositional singular; only the instrumental площадью differs with -ью.

Strategic focus: Accusative singular. The square is the direct object of фотографируют, so it takes the accusative. Because площадь is an inanimate third-declension noun, its accusative is identical to the nominative — the bare -ь form площадь, with no special object ending.

Strategic focus: Instrumental singular. The preposition перед governs the instrumental, and площадь takes its distinctive ending to become площадью. This -ью form is the single point where the third declension breaks pattern: while genitive, dative, and prepositional all share -и, the instrumental singular alone is -ью.

Strategic focus: Prepositional singular. The locational на governs the prepositional, so площадь becomes площади. This -и ending rounds out the singular trio — genitive, dative, and prepositional are all spelled площади — while only the instrumental площадью stands apart.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural. As the plural subject being described, площадь moves to the nominative plural площади. The third-declension plural marks the nominative with -и, the same vowel seen in the singular obliques but here signalling plurality.

Strategic focus: Genitive plural. The negation нет requires the genitive plural, and площадь takes the third-declension ending -ей to become площадей. This -ей is the regular genitive-plural marker for soft feminine nouns of this class, replacing the singular's -и.

Strategic focus: Dative plural. The preposition по in its distributive sense governs the dative, and in the plural площадь takes the ending -ям, giving площадям. Unlike the singular, where dative coincided with genitive and prepositional, the plural cases are clearly distinct.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural. The squares are the direct object of украшает, so they take the accusative plural. Since площадь is inanimate, its accusative plural matches the nominative plural площади rather than the genitive.

Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. The verb славится governs the instrumental, and площадь takes the plural ending -ями to become площадями. The singular's special -ью gives way in the plural to the ordinary -ями ending shared across the declensions.

Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. The locational на governs the prepositional, and площадь becomes площадях with the plural ending -ях. The singular merger of genitive, dative, and prepositional into -и does not apply in the plural, where every case has its own form.
